JPEG encoder of X-T3 5.11, the X-T20 2.11 encoder's register layout. The driver has one accessor per word: +0x44 size, +0x12c origin, +0x130 pitch, +0x100/+0x10c/+0x110 source, destination and limit, +0x84 table loading and +0x8c table words, +0x28 interrupt mask. The driver's start registers its handler on interrupt line 135 (level) before setting +0x00 bit 0. The handler reads the status +0x24, writes it back and takes bit 4 as a finished run, then reads the stream size +0x94. run_ticks (2 ms at 54 MHz) is not measured.

DesignWare USB3 device controller register block; the core registers start at +0xc100. The interrupt line and the command and transaction latencies are declared values for this body. The latencies are not measured.

Indexed USB PHY programming port: a control word at +0x000 (register index in bits 12:8, data in bits 7:0, write strobe at bit 16), a parallel-interface word at +0x004 and the selected register's readback at +0x400. No analog or link-ready behavior is modeled.

SDHCI host page of one card slot. The present-state, capability and version words follow the standard SDHCI layout, and the clock and timeout words are programmed by the driver. The interrupt line is declared for the slot. The vendor words are programmed by the driver; their meanings are not decoded, so they read back their last write. Clock settle and transfer times are assumed, not measured.

JPEG decoder of X-T3 5.11, the X-T20 2.11 decoder's register layout, beside the encoder page. Playback initialises it by writing 1 to +0x118 and waits for status +0x04 bit 16. A run programs the stream +0x10c and its size +0x110, the packed 4:2:2 output +0x100 and its limit +0x104, and starts with +0x00 bit 0. The playback client registers its handler on interrupt line 136 (level), from the interrupt source table of the firmware; the handler reads the status +0x04, takes bit 4 as a finished run (it then reads +0x14 and the output end +0x108) and bit 17 as a failure. In emulation with the X-T20 decoder model, one playback decodes a card JPEG's thumbnail, preview and picture. The stream refill (+0x118 = 4) is not seen. run_ticks (1 ms at 54 MHz) is not measured.

Face detection engine of X-T3 5.11. The driver has one accessor per word or word group: +0x00 stop (bit 0 written clear, then the word is polled until nonzero), +0x04 start, +0x08 mode (bits 2..0 below 5, flags 4, 8, 12, 16), configuration words +0x0c..+0x5fc, +0x6e0/+0x6e4 and +0x710..+0x71c (read back by the driver), results +0x600..+0x608, channel flags +0x700 bits 0, 4, 8, 16, 20, 24 with fields +0x704 cleared by writing +0x708, finished bit 0 at +0x730 and +0x734 (cleared by writing 1), and channel arming +0x738 bit 0. The driver's open programs the configuration and registers its handler on interrupt line 123. Each live view frame's run writes the mode, arms the channels, polls +0x700 until all six flags are set, clears them and sets +0x04 bit 0; the handler reads +0x730, writes it back to +0x734 and posts the finished run to the face task. No image is read and no face is detected: the result words read zero. Arming completes at once; run_ticks (2 ms at 54 MHz) is not measured. Runs in other modes (mode 4) are refused.

Parameter page of the X-T3 5.11 still RECC engine (control page 0xfff82000). The driver's setters write words +0x000..+0x6b0 and read only +0x000 and +0x6b0 back for read-modify-write; nothing polls it. Words read back their last write; what they parameterize is not modeled.

X-T3 5.11 viewfinder output setup, run when VIEW MODE selects the viewfinder: it read-modify-writes +0x004, writes table words to +0x008..+0x014, then writes 0 to +0x000 and waits for bit 0 to read 1; its release sets +0x004 bits 0x1f0fff again.
